name: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault
oneLiner: nOPAL is Nest's vault token wrapping BlackOpal LiquidStone II tokenized credit positions; references a dollar base but behaves like a credit vault share.
collateral: BlackOpal LiquidStone II tokenised credit positions plus stablecoin and Treasury liquidity buffers held inside the Nest vault
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and drifts with the BlackOpal LiquidStone II credit strategy NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserves.name: BlackOpal LiquidStone II tokenized credit positions

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault NAV

notices.title: Private credit strategy, not par stablecoin
notices.message: nOPAL holds BlackOpal LiquidStone II tokenised credit positions. The token references a dollar base but behaves like a credit vault share rather than a 1:1 par stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: nOPAL is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs strategy allocation. There is no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.

controls.label: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens against pUSD deposits at the Accountant-computed NAV; minting is permissioned through the vault rather than open.

controls.label: Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: The Manager contract is Nest-controlled and oversees vault strategy, allocation, and configuration; it sits in the admin path over the BoringVault/Teller issuance.

review.evidence: Nest vaults run the Nucleus BoringVault stack (BoringVault token + Teller minter + Accountant pricing + Nest-controlled Manager); shares are minted only by the Teller on deposit and the Manager governs strategy, so supply creation is fully permissioned by Nest. Teller/Manager addresses taken from Nest's published contract list; on-chain role/owner not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/authority of the Teller and Manager (Safe vs EOA) before raising confidence.
